== Description ==
Oblivion is one of the VERY FEW passive entities and the only one that helps the player through communication.

== Behavior ==
<tabber>
|-|Normal Form=
'''Normal:'''<br>Oblivion is the entity that will tell you how to survive the entities and sometimes may say some extra information about them during it's dialogue. It will also warn you about other entities when inside a run with an example being [[M-60]] and [[M-60i]].

Altrough, '''Oblivion''' is unable guide players on how to survive the Shadow entities due to not them fully understanding what the shadows are or how any of them work.

|-|Corporeal Form=
'''Corporeal Form:'''<br>Look at [[Player Controlled#Corporeal_Oblivion|Player Controlled]]
</tabber>


== Lore ==
'''Oblivion''' Used to live in the [[Unnamed Sector]], that's all we know.

==Trivia==
* '''Oblivion''' lends some of his power to the player when their locker is breached by a [[Player Controlled#Striketeam_Solstice|Striketeam Solstice Member]], [[SHA-200]] or [[LAPSE-200]].
* '''Oblivion''' was taken from the Doors ideas wiki, which can be found [https://doors-ideas.fandom.com/wiki/Oblivion here]
* '''Oblivion''' is replaced by the [[Overseer]] for when a Perfection Event happens, which happen on any Friday the 13th
* he canonically can chug three orange colas at record speeds. Along with that, strangely enough, oblivion was also seen downing an entire can of beans at surprisingly high speeds.
* For the Perfection Events, '''Oblivion''' wont mark lockers for when [[M-60]] and [[M-60i]] spawns, due to [[Overseer]] taking their place for the events.
* Oblivion's Death Screen theme is "All I Had To Do" by Keosz on YouTube, But slightly pitched down.
** https://youtu.be/f640b8FC-eg?si=WawtXyhBdN5qJaKF

*<span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px red; color: red;">'''Remember, Claustrophobia will not attack when certain entities like D-5 are active. Use this to your advantage. '''</span>

*<span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px red; color: red;">'''While it is overcharging, it is still lethal, so wait until after it disappears before leaving hiding.'''</span>
*<span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px red; color: red;">'''This may seem complicated, and it is. Fear not, D-60i is exceptionally rare to encounter. '''</span>
*<span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px red; color: red;">'''Try to remember this information for the next time you meet it!'''</span>
*<span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px red; color: red;">'''...'''</span>
*<span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px red; color: red;">'''Oh, one other thing...'''</span>
*<span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px red; color: red;">'''If you manage to survive long enough,  be ready to think fast.'''</span>
*<span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px red; color: red;">'''In its enraged state, D-60i breaks lockers at random in each room he enters.'''</span>
*<span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px red; color: red;">'''To counter this, your strategy won't need drastic changes; just think faster and make sure you know where hiding spots are.'''</span>
*<span style="text shadow: 0 0 5px red; color: red;">'''You'll do better next time. I believe in you.</span>
